text:
Chen: Heads-up — our 3yr savings plan for p4d in us-west-2 renews in 22 days. Utilization trend has slid from ~88% to ~57% over the last 3 months. Do we want to renew as-is, exchange for convertible, or rightsize to p4de.24xlarge?

Alex: Oof, 57% is low. Any idea which teams / projects are the main idle consumers?

Chen: I pulled a quick tag rollup; looks like: inference-prod (40%), training-exp (25%), batch-embeds (20%), misc/dev (15%). Most of the drop came from training-exp — they moved to spot-heavy clusters in us-east-1 last quarter.

Priya: Can you paste the query you used? I want to cross-check with cost allocation.

Chen: Sure — ran a short billing query:
```
SELECT region, product_family, SUM(used_hours) as hours, SUM(billed_amount) as cost
FROM billing.usage
WHERE instance_type LIKE 'p4%'
  AND start_time >= '2025-12-01'
  AND end_time <= '2026-02-28'
GROUP BY region, product_family
ORDER BY hours DESC;
```
Results snippet:
```
us-west-2 | p4d.24xlarge | 19,200h | $320k
us-east-1 | p4d.24xlarge | 11,900h | $200k
ap-southeast-1 | p4d.24xlarge | 1,100h | $18k
```

Jordan: If training-exp moved to spot in us-east-1 that explains it. For renewals we usually aim for >=70% utilization for 3yr commitment. 57% suggests a Convertible or shorter term.

CostBot: Reminder — exchange penalties for existing RIs are minimal if moving to convertible on the same family. Recommend running the exchange simulator: /cost-sim exchange --from=p4d --to=conv3yr --region=us-west-2

Alex: Two things to consider: (1) Are there any upcoming roadmap projects that will ramp p4 usage in us-west-2 in next 6–12 months? (2) Can we shift any long-running dev workloads to dedicated cheaper instance types or to another region?

Priya: Roadmap note — VQA inference rollout (Q3) will land in us-west-2 but its spike is estimated at ~2k GPU-hours/month, not enough to cover the gap. Dev infra can be shifted; I'll coordinate with platform to tag non-prod and throttle.

Chen: Quick proposal: do not auto-renew identical 3yr. Option A: exchange to 3yr convertible to keep flexibility (small premium). Option B: let it lapse and add a 1yr standard plan for baseline traffic + on-demand for spikes. Option C: migrate some workloads regionally and re-evaluate.

Jordan: I lean convertible 3yr unless Priya can free up 15–20% by throttling dev and re-tagging. Convertible gives us ability to flip to other instance classes if model architecture changes.

Priya: I'll run a dev throttling sweep today and report estimated recovered hours by EOD.

Alex: Also run a quick historical preemption/spike analysis so we don't lose availability if we shift load. Use the cluster-metrics query:
```
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?query=avg_over_time(gpu_utilization[90d])&region=us-west-2"
```

Chen: Noted. I'll queue the exchange-sim after Priya's numbers. If we decide convertible, I'll open a renewal ticket and draft the finance justification (savings vs flexibility).

Priya: ETA EOD. tagging @Alex for follow-up. :thumbsup:

Alex: SG. Thanks everyone. :eyes:

CostBot: Auto-note: renewal window opens in 12 days.
